answer_1.quote: Negotiation dialogue involves psychology, politics, and communication, playing a crucial role in daily life.

answer_2.quote: We utilize two types of evaluation methodologies: goal-based metrics and quality-based metrics.

answer_3.quote: In Section 4.1, it is noted that we employ evaluation powered by LLMs.

answer_4.quote: Initially, we sample 50 dialogues generated by DMNA on both CB and P4G datasets. These dialogues are then annotated by 3 human annotators using the same standard as those applied by the LLM-based evaluator.
answer_4.guideline: using the same standard as those applied by the LLM-based evaluator
